description.value: Heritage House Pub is a community-centred pub in Courtenay, BC, run by a trio with combined backgrounds in cooking, hospitality management, and customer service. The kitchen serves a broad mix of pub classics alongside more inventive offerings like seafood chowder poutine and beet poke bowl. It's a welcoming sit-down stop in the Comox Valley for a meal and cold drink after a ride.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms an active pub at 975 Comox Road, Courtenay, BC, with the same phone number as OSM. The menu pages reveal several identifiable vegetarian dishes (Beet Poke Bowl, Spinach & Artichoke Dip, salads, Yam Fries, Nachos) though no explicit vegan or GF labeling is present. No cyclist-specific amenities such as bike parking, Wi-Fi, or takeout are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM tag 'disused:amenity=restaurant' indicates the location was previously a different restaurant; the current pub operation appears fully active and unrelated to any closure.
OSM opening_hours tag values differ slightly from those shown on the business website, suggesting the OSM record may be mildly out of date.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active pub with a live website, confirmed address and phone, and a full menu — a solid food and drink stop for cyclists in the Comox Valley.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes Beet Poke Bowl (ginger soy tossed beets, sushi seasoned rice — vegetarian), House Salad, Greek Salad, Spinach & Artichoke Dip, Jalapeno Popper Dip, Yam Fries, and plain Nachos. No explicit vegan or GF labeling found on the menu

wow_evidence: community-centred pub in Courtenay...run by a trio with combined backgrounds in cooking, hospitality management
